name: edens-prompt-hub
description: A zero-dependency AI companion workspace for Antigravity IDE & VS Code: parameterized prompts, pinned favorites, SKILL.md repository with 1-click project/global sync, side-by-side Split Panel for RTL/LTR Quick Notes and rendered Markdown Outputs, code insertion, and verification checklists.

edenHub.storagePath.description: Custom directory for storing prompts, notes, checklists, and outputs. Leave empty to use the shared folder (~/.edens-prompt-hub) so data stays synced across VS Code and Antigravity IDE.

edenHub.fontScale.description: Interface text size preset for My AI DevDesk (sm = 14px, md = 16px, lg = 18px).
